name: Evasive steer around a block
detail: with assist: steered around, passed the block (x 4.3 m), closest 9 cm, control handed back; without: emergency braking stopped at x 1.71 m

name: Evasive steer stays out when the driver is already avoiding
detail: driver steered around it themselves: assist intervened for 198 ticks, no contact

name: Evasive steer: no way around -> braking only
detail: wall across the whole room: no escape path, emergency braking stopped it 78 cm short

name: Corridor centring
detail: driver's steering drifts left: with centring the car stays within 0 cm of the centre for 5.1 m; without it is stopped by braking at 1.2 m

name: Centring yields to a deliberate turn
detail: driver turns out of the corridor on purpose: centring lets go (ends 0.10 m to the left)

name: Speed-vs-steering limiter
detail: full throttle at full lock: lateral acceleration 1.20 m/s^2 with the limiter, 2.53 without

name: Narrow gap: won't fit
detail: 18 cm gap for a 20 cm car: 'won't fit' warning, stopped before it (x 1.47 m), no contact

name: Narrow gap: tight but fits
detail: 32 cm gap: slowed, passed through (x 2.1 m), closest 6 cm

name: Side proximity alert
detail: object beside the car: side alert, raised to a warning when the driver steers toward it

name: Dead-man smooth stop
detail: driver link lost at PWM 200: held 0.5 s, then ramped to 0 by 1.18 s (largest step 6 PWM)
